lines.x: People's Bank of China Governor Pan Gongsheng reaffirmed support for the country's stock market in a work report, promising further actions to ease financial strains.
The People's Bank of China announced a new round of a swap facility to channel about $15 billion into the onshore stock market following a severe sell-off.
Chinese regulators have blocked SoftBank Group's planned $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB Robotics.
China has tied future expansions of US agricultural product imports to reciprocal tariff reductions by Washington, according to trade reports.
